create_memory_node.content: Reusable lab infrastructure: receipts, ledgers, certified checkers, seals, and a PMLL bridge.
create_memory_node.label: qforge-toolkit

create_memory_node.content: A candidate is adopted only if it is exact and at least 10% faster on the complete task, with at least three paired repeats at the same thread count. Otherwise it is staged, or rejected if it is not exact.
create_memory_node.label: speedgate-rule

create_memory_node.content: A sealed archive is a copy, never the live tree. Home prefixes are replaced with ~, a leak scan must pass, then MANIFEST and SHA256SUMS are packed. A receipt is taken from a fresh extract, not the retained one.
create_memory_node.label: seal-pipeline

create_memory_node.content: Eigenvalue claims that are meant to be certified use two exact checkers: Sylvester inertia (LDL with 1-by-1 and 2-by-2 pivots, two pivot orders must agree) and Temple's inequality (a lower bound mu - r^2/(zeta - mu) when zeta > mu). Residual disks enclose an eigenvalue only for normal matrices.
create_memory_node.label: temple-inertia

create_memory_node.content: Prose and receipt claims are scanned for unbounded strength words. A hit is allowed when the same sentence limits the claim. not_claimed fields are never scanned.
create_memory_node.label: claim-linter

create_memory_node.content: Does the speed gate adopt only exact, complete-task wins of at least 10%?
create_memory_node.label: CARD-SPEEDGATE

create_memory_node.content: Does the Temple checker refuse a claimed bound tighter than mu - r^2/(zeta - mu)?
create_memory_node.label: CARD-TEMPLE

create_memory_node.content: Sparse certified Temple enclosures for operators that do not fit densely in memory
create_memory_node.label: P-SPARSE-TEMPLE

create_memory_node.content: Carry the exact rational inertia checker into a proof assistant kernel
create_memory_node.label: P-LEAN-INERTIA

create_memory_node.content: Never over-claim: a finite run is not a proof.
create_memory_node.label: guardrail

create_memory_node.content: ADOPT only if exact and at least 10% faster on the complete task.
create_memory_node.label: guardrail

create_memory_node.content: Seal a copy, leak-scan, and receipt from a fresh extract.
create_memory_node.label: guardrail
